thread:
alex: ran into a developer on the sample-app onboarding who couldn't get the JS SDK running in Cloudflare Workers. Error: \"ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined\" and miniflare also flagged unresolved \"node:crypto\" imports.

nina: yep, this is the typical Workers mismatch. We build for browser but some deps still import `node:` specifiers or expect Node globals. What bundler and config?

alex: esbuild, platform=browser, target=es2020. we didn't set any aliases or injects. the lib `legacy-sign` pulls `node:crypto` and `buffer` transitive.

raj: two practical paths: 1) change SDK to avoid Node-only APIs on hot paths (webcrypto-first), and 2) add a tiny opt-in shim for Workers that fixes the small surface we need (base64, minimal Buffer.from/toString, maybe setTimeout hints).

nina: for bundling, prefer esbuild `--inject:src/shims/worker-shims.js` (inject a small global shim) instead of heavy node polyfills. Example shim should only implement base64 and encode/decode not full Buffer. That avoids dragging in node-libs-browser.

alex: good call. How do we stop `node:crypto` from breaking wrangler dev?

raj: alias `node:crypto` and `crypto` to `./src/shims/web-crypto.mjs` for worker builds. For esbuild use the `alias` plugin or `--define:require` tricks. Also add package.json conditional exports: \"worker\": \"./dist/worker/index.mjs\" so bundlers pick a worker-friendly entry.

nina: types wise, TS will complain about Buffer. Add a `global.d.ts` shim: `declare var Buffer:any; export {}` and include it in sample-app tsconfig. Also document \"No fs, no child_process, no native addons\" in onboarding so folks don't reach for Node-only libs.

alex: can we ship a tiny module `redwood-worker-shims` that users import at top of their Worker? That seems easiest for DX.

raj: yes — keep it optional and tiny. We'll also gate Node-only retry/auth code paths using runtime checks like `if (typeof crypto?.subtle === 'object')` and fallback to Node `createHmac` only when `process` exists.

ci-bot: CI suggestion: add a smoke job that runs `esbuild --platform=browser` + `miniflare` start to catch unresolved imports on PRs.

alex: great. nina, can you draft the shim + sample-app README snippet? raj, can you follow up on export map tweaks? I'll add the CI job.

nina: will do. I'll keep the shim <200 lines and call out limitations in README.

raj: I'll open a tiny PR for conditional exports and a worker build test.

alex: thanks — this should cut the onboarding friction significantly. :rocket:
